text:
Claire (AE): Garnet sent redlines: they want a 200k token/month POC credit for 90 days, prefer DocuSign to trigger signing, but procurement insists on PO before invoicing. They also require BYOK (customer-managed KMS) and asked if we can drop SLA to 99.5% during POC. Need advice on routing and billing contingency.
Omar (Solutions Eng): We can do credits applied as invoice credits. BYOK is doable (BYOK/BYOK+HSM patterns) but must call out limitations (cache snapshot, KV persistence). I can draft a 1-page KMS handoff note.
Lee (Sales Ops): Finance: PO before billing unless exec exception. Operational plan: prepare DocuSign envelope with po_number placeholder + contingency clause that delays billable activation until PO arrives. Set signer routing to allow parallel customer legal + eng.
Nina (Legal): We avoid MSA SLA edits. Recommend a POC addendum: "POC Term: 90 days; SLA during POC: 99.5% (if accepted); liability cap = fees paid during POC; commencement contingent on PO or Provider may suspend billable services after 21 days." Also add BYOK appendix clarifying no provider access to plaintext keys and effects on features.
Claire (AE): Customer redline pasted: ```
Order form excerpt:
- POC credits: 200,000 tokens/month x 3 months applied as invoice credit
- Services commence on countersignature; PO to follow within 10 days
- KMS: Customer-managed keys; provider shall not access plaintext keys
- Overage: billed at 60% of list until credits exhausted
```
Omar (Solutions Eng): 60% is workable for POC. Need explicit meter definition: "Token units measured per UTC-month by Provider billing meter." I'll add examples.
Lee (Sales Ops): DocuSign template ord-poc-2025 supports parallel signing and addenda. I'll pre-fill envelope with placeholders and set routing: cust_legal & cust_proc parallel -> cust_eng -> provider_ae -> provider_finance (visibility).
contract-bot: Template note: ord-poc-2025 fields: po_number, credit_amount, overage_rate, poc_term. Template ID: tmpl-ord-poc-2025. Envelope draft created: env-77533.
Nina (Legal): Addendum draft uploaded: https://redwood-internal.share/poc-addenda/garnet-poc-addendum. Includes PO contingency, liability cap, BYOK appendix, and overage clause. Please review.
Claire (AE): I'll ask Garnet to upload PO and request they sign procurement in parallel. If they push for DocuSign-first, we'll require sandbox-only activation until PO arrives.
Lee (Sales Ops): Ready to send envelope. Will wait for PO paste. Contract bot set envelope to wait for po_number autofill.
contract-bot: Action logged: env-77533 awaiting PO value.
Claire (AE): PO 48011233 received and pasted. Sending envelope now.
Nina (Legal): Final redlines accepted. Countersign after customer completes signatures.
Lee (Sales Ops): Envelope completed and countersigned. Sandbox active; full production and KMS handoff scheduled for next Tue.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Posted KMS handoff note and checklist to thread. Will run handoff with Garnet eng next Tue.
Claire (AE): POC live. Thanks everyone! :tada:
